proof:
Source. Simon, Ch. 3, chapter-03.txt lines 393-396 (printed p. 77): “the (easily checked) fact that if f : U → ℝᵐ is locally Lipschitz and B has Hⁿ-measure zero, then Hⁿ(f(B)) = 0”. Step 6 of the parent proof justifies it as “cover U by countably many balls on which f is Lipschitz”.

The one-set estimate is Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.8(i) (chapter-02.txt lines 270-292). Its proof is valid for non-measurable sets (“this part of the argument is valid even if A is not Hᵐ-measurable”). Library form: SimonGMT Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn (Chapter02/Lipschitz.lean): LipschitzOnWith K f A → μHE[n] (f '' A) ≤ Kⁿ · μHE[n] A, for every set A.

Notation.
- ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d).
- Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^N and on ℝ^P, evaluated on arbitrary sets as an outer measure.
- LocallyLipschitzOn U f (Mathlib) means: for every x ∈ U there are K ≥ 0 and t ∈ 𝓝[U] x such that f is K-Lipschitz on t.

Neither openness of U nor measurability of Z is needed.

Proof.
1. Local neighbourhoods. Let x ∈ Z. Since Z ⊆ U, there are K_x ≥ 0 and t_x ∈ 𝓝[U] x with f K_x-Lipschitz on t_x. By the definition of the neighbourhood filter within U (Mathlib mem_nhdsWithin), there is an open o_x ⊆ ℝ^N with x ∈ o_x and o_x ∩ U ⊆ t_x. So f is K_x-Lipschitz on o_x ∩ U.
2. Countable subcover. ℝ^N is second countable, so the family of open sets (o_x)_{x∈Z} has a countable subfamily with the same union (Mathlib TopologicalSpace.isOpen_biUnion_countable). That is, there is a countable T ⊆ Z with ⋃_{x∈T} o_x = ⋃_{x∈Z} o_x. Since x ∈ o_x for every x ∈ Z, we get Z ⊆ ⋃_{x∈T} o_x, and therefore f(Z) ⊆ ⋃_{x∈T} f(Z ∩ o_x).
3. One piece. Fix x ∈ T. Because Z ⊆ U, we have Z ∩ o_x ⊆ o_x ∩ U, so f is K_x-Lipschitz on Z ∩ o_x. By the Lipschitz image estimate (valid for arbitrary sets) and monotonicity of the outer measure: Hⁿ(f(Z ∩ o_x)) ≤ K_xⁿ · Hⁿ(Z ∩ o_x) ≤ K_xⁿ · Hⁿ(Z) = 0.
4. Conclusion. By Step 2, f(Z) is contained in the countable union of the sets f(Z ∩ o_x), x ∈ T. Each of these is Hⁿ-null by Step 3. By countable subadditivity and monotonicity (Mathlib measure_biUnion_null_iff, measure_mono_null), Hⁿ(f(Z)) = 0. (If Z = ∅, then T = ∅ and the union is empty.) ∎

Appendix: formalization aid, not part of the mathematical argument. Below is a kernel-checked scratch proof of exactly this statement. It was elaborated after `import GMT.Ch03.Submission` in the contract scope (namespace GMT.Ch03 plus the contract's opens) and uses only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. When transplanting, rename C1check to Submission.areaFormula_image_null_of_locallyLipschitzOn.

theorem C1check : ∀ (N P n : ℕ) (U Z : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn P), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → Z ⊆ U → μHE[n] Z = 0 → μHE[n] (f '' Z) = 0 := by
  intro N P n U Z f hf hZU hZ
  classical
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Z, ∃ o : Set (Rn N), IsOpen o ∧ x ∈ o ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K f (o ∩ U) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨K, t, ht, hK⟩ := hf (hZU hx)
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hxo, hot⟩ := mem_nhdsWithin.mp ht
    exact ⟨o, ho, hxo, K, hK.mono hot⟩
  choose! o ho hxo K hK using key
  obtain ⟨T, hTZ, hTc, hTU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_biUnion_countable Z o ho
  have hcov : f '' Z ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ T, f '' (Z ∩ o x) := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hz' : z ∈ ⋃ x ∈ Z, o x := mem_biUnion hz (hxo z hz)
    rw [← hTU] at hz'
    obtain ⟨x, hxT, hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hz'
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x, hxT, z, ⟨hz, hzx⟩, rfl⟩
  refine measure_mono_null hcov ((measure_biUnion_null_iff hTc).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  have hL : LipschitzOnWith (K x) f (Z ∩ o x) :=
    (hK x (hTZ hx)).mono fun z hz ↦ ⟨hz.2, hZU hz.1⟩
  refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  calc μHE[n] (f '' (Z ∩ o x)) ≤ (K x : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * μHE[n] (Z ∩ o x) :=
        Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn n hL
    _ = 0 := by rw [measure_mono_null inter_subset_left hZ, mul_zero]
key_steps: For each x ∈ Z ⊆ U pick an open o_x ∋ x with f K_x-Lipschitz on o_x ∩ U (definition of LocallyLipschitzOn and mem_nhdsWithin).
Lindelöf (second countability of ℝ^N): countably many o_x, x ∈ T, cover Z.
Hⁿ(f(Z ∩ o_x)) ≤ K_xⁿ Hⁿ(Z ∩ o_x) = 0, by the Lipschitz image bound for arbitrary sets.
